## New entry: Higress

This PR adds **[Higress](https://github.com/alibaba/higress)** to the **Frameworks & Infrastructure → Orchestration & Multi-Agent** subcategory, directly alongside **agentgateway**.

### Why this category

Higress is placed next to **agentgateway** (Solo.io) — the closest analogous project already in the landscape. Both are unified, full-featured AI gateways that span MCP, agent-to-agent communication, and LLM inference under a single control plane, so they belong in the same box rather than in MCP Infrastructure.

### Why it fits

- **Cloud-native AI Gateway**: production-grade AI gateway built on Envoy and Istio, providing a unified control plane for LLM API management, **MCP (Model Context Protocol) server hosting & registry**, and AI agent traffic governance.
- **CNCF Sandbox project** — part of the Linux Foundation / CNCF ecosystem.
- **Open source, ~9k GitHub stars**, well above the 1000-star threshold.

### Checklist
- [x] Added next to agentgateway in Orchestration & Multi-Agent
- [x] Logo added to `hosted_logos/` (official Higress wordmark, name in English, non-reversed, transparent background)
- [x] `repo_url`, `homepage_url`, `description`, and `crunchbase` (Alibaba Group, the controlling org) provided
